_note: Numbers measured while building this project (15 Oct 2026). Every value comes from a run of the tools in ../tools on the author's own board-camera recordings; recordings are not published.

arm_found_by_camera_view.metric: share of frames where MoveNet's right-arm keypoints pass the plausibility gate (tools/pose_arm.py arm_vectors, min score 0.04)

smoothing_one_euro.metric: frame-to-frame motion left in the IK joint angles after the One-Euro filter, as % of the raw motion; lag at 15 fps

learned_student_vs_mean_pose.metric: median upper-arm direction error in degrees, seen from the front (lower is better); baseline = always the mean teacher pose of the test frames (an oracle constant)

gripper_freihand.metric: open/closed accuracy on the held-out 15% of 6000 FreiHAND images; 'far' = hand shrunk to 24 px then enlarged
gripper_freihand.on_authors_own_footage: not reliable: crops often miss the hand; no labelled frames, so no accuracy is claimed

hardware_link.bench_link_test: 5 of 5 PASS (armed, run, no relax while frames flow, watchdog HOLD, host RELAX); frames=100, bad_crc=0
